summary: Stellar Bancorp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.15 per share declared by its Board on May 20, 2026, payable June 26, 2026 to holders of record June 15, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special situation attributes such as a tender, spin-off, restructuring, or activist event. The filing includes a press release with forward-looking language. As a standard quarterly dividend, there are no deal terms, advisor involvement, or regulatory hurdles to monitor.
